{{Quote|I first tasted zoochberries while trading furbogs along the Corellian Run. Through these exchanges I ended up possessing any number of unusual items: hyperdrive attentuators, silicon-pronged tack trim, Sullustan gab-rippers and&mdash;you guessed it&mdash;more zoochberries than I knew what to do with.|Dexter Jettster in his diner's menu|<ref name="Dex" />}}
'''Zoochberries''' were a [[Berry/Legends|berry]] used in a variety of [[Foodstuff/Legends|dishes]], including [[Zoochberry cobbler|cobblers]], [[Zoochberry cream/Legends|cream]], [[Zoochberry dumpling|dumplings]], [[Zoochberry juice/Legends|juice]], [[Zoochberry pie/Legends|pie]], and [[Zoochberry topping|topping]]. Dishes that used them were [[Diet/Legends|edible]] by [[Besalisk/Legends|Besalisks]], [[Human/Legends|Humans]], [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]], and [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]]. The Besalisk [[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster]] consumed zoochberries [[Standard day/Legends|daily]] after discovering them, and he later used them in several dishes at his [[Dex's Diner/Legends|diner]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. Jettster also served zoochberries as a side for multiple breakfast meals. Other dishes that used zoochberries were eaten throughout the [[Trioculus affair]] of [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]]. Multiple idioms also involved the berries and the dishes that used them.

==Description==
{{Quote|I ended up eating zoochberries almost daily, and one of my favorite ways to have them was in a fine cobbler such as this one.|Dexter Jettster in his diner's menu|<ref name="Dex" />}}
Zoochberries were a type of [[Berry/Legends|berry]] used in various [[Foodstuff/Legends|dishes]], including deserts. The dishes included [[zoochberry cobbler]],<ref name="Dex" /> [[Zoochberry cream/Legends|zoochberry cream]],<ref name="Glove" /> [[zoochberry dumpling]],<ref name="Prophets" /> [[Zoochberry juice/Legends|zoochberry juice]],<ref name="Zorba" /> [[Zoochberry pie/Legends|zoochberry pie]],<ref name="Lost" /> [[Zoochberry syrup]],<ref name="TOR:PfaD" /> and [[zoochberry topping]]. Dishes using the berries were [[Diet/Legends|edible]] by [[Besalisk/Legends|Besalisks]],<ref name="Dex" /> [[Human/Legends|Humans]],<ref name="Zorba" /> [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]],<ref name="Prophets" /> [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]],<ref name="Lost" /> [[Cathar/Legends|Cathars]], [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]], [[Miraluka/Legends|Miralukas]], [[Mirialan/Legends|Mirialans]], [[Nautolan/Legends|Nautolans]], [[Rattataki/Legends|Rattataki]], [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith]], [[Togruta/Legends|Togrutas]], [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'leks]] and [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabraks]].<ref name="TOR:FPS" />

==History==
===A tasty ingredient&hellip;===
{{Quote|Congratulations Chewie, that was about the best zoochberry pie I've ever had.|Luke Skywalker, to Chewbacca|<ref name="Lost" />}}
[[File:Dexs_Diner.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Dishes containing zoochberries were served at Dex's Diner.]]
The Besalisk [[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster]] first encountered zoochberries as a [[Merchant/Legends|trader]] of [[furbog]]s on the [[Corellian Run/Legends|Corellian Run]]<ref name="Dex" /> [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]],<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> where he came into possession of more zoochberries than he could handle. According to Jettster, one furbog was worth ten times its weight in zoochberries, and he found himself consuming the berries almost [[Standard day/Legends|daily]], including in a cobbler. Jettster later opened an [[Restaurant/Legends|eatery]] named [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]<ref name="Dex" /> at some point no earlier than [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]],<ref name="DexDates">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/dexdiner/index.html|text=Dining at Dex's|int=Dining at Dex's}} is set at some point no earlier than [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]] per the {{DiningAtDexDate}}.</ref> where he recounted his discovery of zoochberries in its menu. The diner served zoochberry cobblers as a dessert for 2.7 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]], charging a further three credits to be served with a scoop of [[denta bean ice cream]]. Jettster also offered a choice of zoochberries or [[ettel nut]]s as a side for the breakfast meals [[Panna cake]] and [[Iktotch toast]] for one extra credit and served [[Neuvian sundae]]s with a choice of [[Trammistan chocolate]] or zoochberry topping.<ref name="Dex" /> 

During the [[Trioculus affair]]<ref name="Glove" /> of [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> zoochberry [[Cream/Legends|cream]] was served alongside [[Whaladon/Legends|Whaladon]] meat in a meeting of the Empire's [[Central Committee of Grand Moffs]] on the planet [[Kessel/Legends|Kessel]]. After becoming frustrated during the meeting, the newly declared [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Galactic Emperor]] [[Trioculus]] knocked over a serving flask of zoochberry cream.<ref name="Glove" /> Some [[Time/Legends|time]] afterward, the Human [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] visited his friend [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] at the latter's new [[Han Solo's sky house|sky house]] on the planet [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]], where Solo's Wookiee companion [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] used his newfound [[Chef/Legends|cooking]] skills to prepare zoochberry [[Pie/Legends|pie]]. Skywalker subsequently stated that it was the best zoochberry pie he had ever tasted.<ref name="Lost" />

===&hellip;for all purposes===
{{Quote|Simple as zoochberry pie.|Lando Calrissian|<ref name="Queen" />}}
[[File:ZorbaFace-QE.png|thumb|left|270px|Zorba Desilijic Tiure consumed zoochberry dumplings at Scardia Station.]]
While the Trioculus affair continued, [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina/Legends|Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina]] on the planet [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] served zoochberry juice. There, the [[Barabel/Legends|Barabel]] [[Tibor]] suggested that the Hutt [[Zorba Desilijic Tiure]] consume a [[Glass/Legends|glass]] of the juice while calming down. Later, Solo hosted a housewarming party at his [[Atmosphere/Legends|sky]] house where he ensured that his guest's zoochberry juice glasses were full in his capacity as host, as there was a significant quantity available.<ref name="Zorba" /> When Solo and his romantic partner, [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], traveled to [[Hologram Fun World]] to be [[Marriage/Legends|married]], they met their friend [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] there, who poured glasses of zoochberry juice for each of them. When the couple realized that they needed their [[birth certificate]]s, which were unavailable, Calrissian expressed through an idiom that getting new copies at the [[Document Bureau]] would be as simple as zoochberry pie.<ref name="Queen">''[[Queen of the Empire]]''</ref>

Later, Organa was captured by Zorba and the Imperial [[Moff/Legends|Moffs]] to be forcibly married to Trioculus. While launching a [[Rescue of Leia Organa|rescue]] attempt on the [[Moffship]], Solo quipped that finding Organa could turn out like looking for a [[micro-chip]] in a field of zoochberries.<ref name="Queen" /> Zorba later traveled to [[Scardia Station]], home of the<ref name="Prophets" /> imposters of the<ref name="SPIN">{{SW|url=news/the-star-wars-spy-game-spin-declassified|text=The ''Star Wars'' Spy Game: SPIN Declassified|int=The Star Wars Spy Game: SPIN Declassified|nolive=1}}</ref> [[Prophets of the Dark Side]], who hosted a large banquet for the Hutt's arrival, which included zoochberry dumplings. Zorba consumed them hastily, spilling some of the dumplings on the [[Robe/Legends|robe]] of<ref name="Prophets" /> [[Heingort Giddis]], an imposter of the [[High Prophet]]<ref name="SPIN" /> [[Jedgar]].<ref name="Prophets" />

==Behind the scenes==
Zoochberries were first mentioned in their cream dish form in the [[1992]] junior novel ''[[The Glove of Darth Vader]]'', written by [[Paul Davids|Paul]] and [[Hollace Davids]].<ref name="Glove" /> They were first referred to independently of any dishes in [[1993]]'s ''[[Queen of the Empire]]'', a junior novel also by Paul and Hollace Davids, in the same [[Adventures of a Jedi Prince|series]] as ''The Glove of Darth Vader''.<ref name="Queen" />
